summary: Map app.whenReady() to a native host readiness task without changing the one-time readiness boundary.

target.notes: The helper completes only after the native application host reaches the same initialization boundary represented by Electron's ready event.

semantics.ordering: must not complete before host initialization

caveats: Electron ready is emitted after the main process finishes its first event-loop tick; native host timing must define an equivalent boundary.

tests.name: await readiness
tests.expected_behavior: ready is observed only after the application host is initialized

tests.name: already ready
tests.expected_behavior: both awaits fulfill; the second call does not reinitialize the application
